detail.longDescription: 🐧 New Steam Client Update Introduces Linux 64-Bit Support, Steam Achievement Sets Valve released a new stable Steam Client update today with a 64-bit build for Linux systems, Steam Achievement Sets, support for GameInput v4, and more. 📰 Source: Tux Machines 🔗 Link: https://tuxmachines.org/n/2026/11/12/New_Steam_Client_Update_Introduces_Linux_64_Bit_Support_Steam_A.shtml # Linux # OpenSource # SteamDeck # PCGaming
